query.default: select distinct employee.persnumber_company_sungero as persnumber, employee."name" as employeeName, jobTitle."name" as jobTitleName, vacationsinfor.structuraldepa as departmentName, vacationKind.Name as VacationType, vacationsinfor.DaysAmount, TO_CHAR(vacationsinfor.StartDate, 'DD.MM.YYYY') as StartDate, TO_CHAR(vacationsinfor.EndDate, 'DD.MM.YYYY') as EndDate, vacationsinfor.StartDate as StartDateOrder from dirrx_nnvacat_vacationsinfor as vacationsinfor join sungero_core_recipient as employee on employee.id = vacationsinfor.employee join sungero_company_jobTitle as jobTitle on jobTitle.id = employee.jobtitle_company_sungero left join hrpro_vacatio_vacationkind as vacationKind on vacationsinfor.VacationType = vacationKind.id where not @Consent and (not vacationsinfor.consenthrpro or vacationsinfor.consenthrpro is null) and vacationsinfor.status = 'Active' and (@DepartmentId = 0 or vacationsinfor.department = @DepartmentId) and vacationsinfor.vacationschedu = @VacationScheduleId order by employeeName, StartDateOrder

select distinct employee.persnumber_company_sungero as persnumber, employee."name" as employeeName, jobTitle."name" as jobTitleName, doc.structuraldepa_overrid_dirrx as departmentName, vacationKind.Name as VacationType, vacationsinfor.DaysAmount, TO_CHAR(vacationsinfor.StartDate, 'DD.MM.YYYY') as StartDate, TO_CHAR(vacationsinfor.EndDate, 'DD.MM.YYYY') as EndDate, vacationsinfor.StartDate as StartDateOrder from sungero_content_edoc as doc join sungero_core_recipient as employee on employee.id = doc.employeedirrx_overrid_dirrx join sungero_company_jobTitle as jobTitle on jobTitle.id = employee.jobtitle_company_sungero join dirrx_nnvacat_vacationsinfor as vacationsinfor on vacationsinfor.employee = employee.id left join hrpro_vacatio_vacationkind as vacationKind on vacationsinfor.VacationType = vacationKind.id where @Consent and doc.acquiantanceop_overrid_dirrx = 'Electronic' and (@DepartmentId = 0 or doc.department_docflow_sungero = @DepartmentId) and doc.vacationschedu_overrid_dirrx = @VacationScheduleId and doc.intapprstate_docflow_sungero = 'Aborted' and doc.documentkind_docflow_sungero = @DocKindId and vacationsinfor.vacationschedu = @VacationScheduleId order by employeeName, StartDateOrder
